# The VFX Armory, vendored

Generated by `scripts/engine/armory/vendor.mts` from the VFX Armory (github.com/TheDudeCommits/vfx-armory) @ `734f147f39b43c3ec1e90f5978758f50e0bf777b`. Do not edit: re-run the tool.

Fighters in the rollout (`src/engine/vfx/rollout.json`): konta, shiden, kagari, tobari, bellows, shakugo, shidare, hinomoto, irbis, hikui, basilissa, pyroclast, full-beam, sorayomi, wataame, shijima, buna, shibuichi, psyche, kinu, kusushi, rakucho, gosu, amagoi, akayuri, sashigane, adad, madake, kubiwa, bonsho, suzuran, minase, mikage, tancho, ume, shanxiao, ampere, strix, kuzu, onigawara, tokan, hisame, senko, oyashio, hakushi, strappado, hagure, highsun, tempo, ovid, hawser, lanthorn, unari, shakudo, mizuhiki, murex, rotfalke, torsion, akaito, chohan, tsubute, aqrab, yodaka, barrow.

## Licences

This is the open part of the VFX Armory: the effects and files under open licences. The Armory's own effects, sound recipes and remade models (VFX Armory Licence) are not in this repository. `config/settings.js` carries the Armory's own notice beside the Elemental Sandbox's MIT one: it is the settings shell every effect here reads, provided under the VFX Armory Licence, not this repository's MIT licence.

- The Armory's code: MIT (`LICENSE` here), built on the Elemental Sandbox (MIT). Every file keeps the notices it carries.
- The p27 pack: ported from itzmitto/Ability-ThreeJS-Project, MIT (`abilities/p27/lib/LICENSE-ability-project-27.txt`).
- Effekseer for WebGL v1.80.7: MIT (its notice heads `effekseer.min.js`). Its sample effects: CC0 (`fx/LICENSE-samples-CC0.txt`); credit Effekseer and the sample authors.
- Credit: remake/dragon.glb: cinematic dragon.glb: "Black Dragon with Idle Animation" by 3DHaupt, CC BY-NC 4.0, credited on the credits page; non-commercial, so replaced before any monetisation
- Credit: cinematic/models/magical_gyroscope.glb: magical_gyroscope.glb: "Magical gyroscope" by reddification, CC BY 4.0, credited on the credits page
- Credit: extended/models/snake.glb: snake.glb: "Two- Headed Snake FBX" by Providence Secretary (NIEZDE), CC BY 4.0, credited on the credits page

## Sound

- Synth recipes: the Armory's `src/audio/recipes.js` (original work, MIT), at `audio/recipes.js`.
- Sample banks (CC0 1.0; sources in `public/assets/armory/sfx/CREDITS.md`): air, bang, bell, blade, boom_low, bubble, cannon, chain, clang, creak, crunch, draw, firework, glass, glitch, gong, laser, laser_small, loop_engine, loop_fire, loop_force, loop_rain, loop_water, mining, paper, plate, punch_heavy, punch_med, roar, rubble, slam, slime, spell, spell_fire, splash, swish, thud, thunder, wood.
